title: Calibration Alignment Fee on Calibration Workmanship Warranty Diagnostic Charges
content:
**Rule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a calibration alignment fee is added to the calibration diagnostic charge posted on a calibration fault found not covered under a Calibration Workmanship Warranty. The calibration alignment fee follows the four-wheel alignment checks recorded as out of specification on the customer's calibration orders under ADAS Sensor Calibrations:

- two or more such checks: the calibration alignment fee is the alignment check fee of the calibration tier of the order the coverage was issued on, as that ADAS Sensor Calibrations tier states it;
- exactly one such check: the calibration alignment fee is the alignment verification fee, USD 29.95;
- no such check: there is no calibration alignment fee.

## Questions and answers

Q. Which alignment checks are counted?
A. Four-wheel alignment checks recorded as out of specification, on any of the customer's calibration orders, not only the order the coverage was issued on. Checks recorded within specification are not counted.

Q. With two out-of-specification checks, whose alignment check fee is used?
A. The alignment check fee of the ADAS Sensor Calibrations tier of the calibration order the coverage was issued on.

Q. With one out-of-specification check, what is added?
A. The alignment verification fee of USD 29.95.

Q. With no out-of-specification check?
A. Nothing: there is no calibration alignment fee.

## Count boundaries

| Out-of-specification checks on the customer's calibration orders | Calibration alignment fee |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | USD 29.95 |
| 2 | the alignment check fee of the source order's calibration tier |
| 3 or more | the alignment check fee of the source order's calibration tier |
